propositions: Comment triage alone cannot reduce two size-pressured files (event_append.py 791/800, _processors.py 777/800) below their limits because their comments encode replay-compatibility justifications that are load-bearing.

Multiple verified-stale comments reference nonexistent modules, incorrect paths, or superseded behavior and must be corrected or deleted: gitutil.py (false 'no rebar imports' claim), llm_format.py (stale package path ticket_reducer→reducer, missing four key maps), hlc.py (kill-switch described as one-release temporary over four schema bumps), filters.py (bash/Python duality no longer present).

Two documentation homes for the wire-format changelog (reducer/_version.py and docs/event-schema.md) contain divergent and incomplete information; docs version is missing v4/v5 entries and must be synchronized as the canonical source before the code copy collapses to a citation.

The highest-risk do_not_move block (reducer/_processors.py:719-774) contains four snapshot-restore migration guards whose inline rationale must remain verbatim; relocating the comments would render live guards appear as dead defensive code, and one guard explicitly warns against unconditional execution.
